questions.stem: Which of the following is a renewable resource?
questions.solution: The Sun is a renewable resource because it provides energy continuously and is not depleted. Petrol and natural gas are non-renewable, and soil is considered a non-renewable resource as it takes a long time to form.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक नवीकरणीय संसाधन है?
hi.solution: सूर्य एक नवीकरणीय संसाधन है क्योंकि यह लगातार ऊर्जा प्रदान करता है और इसका उपभोग नहीं होता है। पेट्रोल और प्राकृतिक गैस अनवीकरणीय हैं, और मिट्टी को एक अनवीकरणीय संसाधन माना जाता है क्योंकि इसके बनने में लंबा समय लगता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options are correctly translated and maintain their original status as correct or incorrect. The term 'नवीकरणीय संसाधन' is the standard term used in Hindi science textbooks.

questions.stem: If a person holds their breath for too long, what happens to their body?
questions.solution: When a person holds their breath for too long, the body accumulates carbon dioxide and lacks oxygen, leading to discomfort and fatigue. The correct option reflects the natural physiological response to breath-holding. The other options do not align with how the body reacts to oxygen deprivation.

hi.stem: यदि कोई व्यक्ति अपनी सांस लंबे समय तक रोक लेता है, तो उसके शरीर में क्या होता है?
choices: उन्हें अधिक ऊर्जावान महसूस होता है
उन्हें थके हुए और असहज महसूस होता है
वे तैरना शुरू कर देते हैं
hi.solution: जब कोई व्यक्ति अपनी सांस लंबे समय तक रोक लेता है, तो शरीर में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड जमा हो जाता है और ऑक्सीजन की कमी हो जाती है, जिसके कारण असहजता और थकान होती है। सही विकल्प सांस रोकने के प्राकृतिक शारीरिक प्रतिक्रिया को प्रतिबिंबित करता है। अन्य विकल्प ऑक्सीजन की कमी के प्रति शरीर की प्रतिक्रिया के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options are correctly translated and maintain their intended meaning. The correct answer remains in the same position (option 2).

mr.stem: जर एखादा व्यक्ती खूप लांब वेळ आपला श्वास रोखत रहे, तर त्याच्या शरीरावर काय परिणाम होतो?
mr.solution: जर एखादा व्यक्ती खूप लांब वेळ आपला श्वास रोखत रहे, तर शरीरात कार्बन डायऑक्साइड जमा होतो आणि ऑक्सीजनची कमतरता होते, ज्यामुळे असोयी आणि थकवा होतो. बरोबर विकल्प श्वास रोखण्यामुळे होणाऱ्या शारीरिक प्रतिक्रियेचे प्रतिनिधित्व करतो. इतर विकल्प ऑक्सीजनच्या कमतरतेमुळे शरीराच्या प्रतिक्रियेशी जुळत नाहीत.

questions.stem: If a school starts a rainwater harvesting system, what would be a direct benefit?
questions.solution: Rainwater harvesting helps in conserving water. The direct benefit would be more water available for use, such as for drinking or other purposes. The other options are not related to the benefits of rainwater harvesting.

hi.stem: यदि एक स्कूल वर्षा जल संग्रहण प्रणाली शुरू करता है, तो एक सीधा लाभ क्या होगा?
hi.solution: वर्षा जल संग्रहण पानी के संरक्षण में मदद करता है। सीधा लाभ उपयोग के लिए उपलब्ध पानी के अधिक होने के रूप में होगा, जैसे पीने के लिए या अन्य उद्देश्यों के लिए। अन्य विकल्प वर्षा जल संग्रहण के लाभ से संबंधित नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for a school-level science context.

mr.stem: जर शाळा वर्षाव जल संचयन प्रणाली सुरू करेल, तर एक थेट फायदा काय असेल?
mr.solution: वर्षाव जल संचयनामुळे पाणी बचत होतो. थेट फायदा म्हणजे वापरासाठी उपलब्ध पाणी जास्त होतो, जे पिण्यासाठी किंवा इतर उद्देशांसाठी असू शकते. इतर विकल्प वर्षाव जल संचयनाच्या फायद्यांशी संबंधित नाहीत.

questions.stem: If a person collects soil samples from different places, what is the most likely reason for the variation in their appearance?
choices: Different types of plants grow in different places
Different types of animals live in different places
Different materials are present in the soil
Different weather conditions affect the soil
questions.solution: The most likely reason for the variation in the appearance of soil samples is that different materials are present in the soil. These materials, such as minerals, organic matter, and other substances, can affect the color and texture of the soil. Other factors, like plants or animals, may influence the soil indirectly but do not directly cause the variation in appearance as clearly as the composition of the soil itself.

hi.stem: यदि कोई व्यक्ति विभिन्न स्थानों से मिट्टी के नमूने एकत्र करता है, तो उनके दिखावट में अंतर के लिए सबसे संभावित कारण क्या है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a natural resource that can be used to generate electricity?
questions.solution: Wind is a natural resource that can be harnessed to generate electricity through wind turbines. Plastic, cement, and glass are synthetic materials created by humans and do not occur naturally in the environment.

questions.stem: If a family uses solar panels for electricity, what would happen if there was no sunlight for a week?
choices: They would run out of electricity
They would use more wind energy
They would use more fossil fuels
questions.solution: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight. If there was no sunlight for a week, the family would not be able to generate electricity through solar panels, leading to a temporary loss of electricity. The other options are not directly related to the use of solar panels.

questions.stem: If a student collects soil samples from a farm and from a forest, what is the most likely difference they might observe?
choices: The farm soil will have more nutrients
The forest soil will be drier
The farm soil will have more earthworms
The forest soil will have more decomposed plant matter
questions.solution: Forest soil is likely to have more decomposed plant matter because the natural cycle of leaves and plant material decaying on the forest floor contributes to rich organic content. Farm soil may have fewer decomposed materials due to regular tilling and removal of plant residues. The other options are not directly related to the natural decomposition process in forests.

questions.stem: If a windmill farm uses the energy of the wind to generate electricity, which of the following is a direct benefit of this use?
choices: It reduces dependence on fossil fuels
questions.solution: Using wind to generate electricity relies on a renewable energy source, which decreases the need for non-renewable and polluting fossil fuels.
